title: Rigidity and equidistribution of random walks by diffeomorphisms near the conservative regime
summary: We consider a random walk on a closed manifold $M$ driven by a probability measure $μ$ on the space of $C^2$ diffeomorphisms. Provided $μ$ has compact support, satisfies certain gap and pinching conditions, and is weak-$*$ close to a volume-preserving measure, we prove that $M$ carries a unique atom-free stationary probability measure $Υ_μ$. This measure has full Frostman dimension and coincides with volume in the volume-preserving setting.
